eyebrow.zh: 反代 · 预算树 · 抢占

headline.zh:
给 Agent 的 token
装上 cgroups

sub.zh: tokenctl 是一个反代 Claude / OpenAI / Bedrock 的 Go 二进制，按 org → team → dev 预算树实时归账，越线软节流，超额硬拒绝，抢占式让权给高权重节点。
sub.en: tokenctl is a single Go binary that reverse-proxies Claude, OpenAI and Bedrock, accounts every streamed token against an org → team → dev budget tree, soft-throttles at the line, hard-denies over it, and preempts for higher-weight nodes.

body.zh: internal/proxy 反代 Claude / OpenAI / Bedrock，解析流式 SSE 响应逐 token 计量，计量增量实时回流到每个 leaf 节点。
body.en: internal/proxy reverse-proxies Claude, OpenAI and Bedrock, parsing the streamed SSE response to meter token by token, with the deltas flowing back to each leaf node in real time.

body.zh: internal/budget 跑一棵递归预算树的单仲裁 goroutine：准入、超 80% 软节流、超 100% 硬拒绝（429 + X-TokenCtl-Reason）。
body.en: internal/budget runs a single arbiter goroutine over a recursive budget tree: admit, soft-throttle past 80%, hard-deny past 100% (429 + X-TokenCtl-Reason).

body.zh: 当高权重兄弟节点缺粮时，仲裁器会抢占在飞的低权重请求，把 slack 让给更重要的流量 —— 不是先到先得的静态配额。
body.en: When a higher-weight sibling starves, the arbiter preempts in-flight lower-weight requests and hands the slack to the more important traffic — not a static first-come quota.

title.zh: 一个二进制，零外部依赖

body.zh: internal/store 用内嵌 BoltDB 持久化窗口内计数与 append-only 审计日志；Prometheus /metrics 与 tokenctl top 暴露实时状态。没有外部 DB、没有消息队列。
body.en: internal/store persists windowed counts and an append-only audit log in embedded BoltDB; Prometheus /metrics and tokenctl top expose live state. No external DB, no message queue.

headline.zh: 把 Agent 账单管起来

sub.zh: Apache-2.0 许可；一份 YAML 描述预算树，把 ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL 指过来即可执行。
sub.en: Apache-2.0 licensed; one YAML describes the budget tree, point ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL at it to enforce.
